contiguous_source.description: Two symbolic far calls at offsets 0 and 6 in one contiguous TASM source block.

ordered_org_source.description: The far call at offset 6 is emitted first with ORG 6; the far call at offset 0 follows with ORG 0.
ordered_org_source.result: descending FIXUPP record order with correct final segment bytes

implication: TASM 1.0 can naturally emit descending explicit FIXUPP records when source contributions are ordered by descending address. The arithmetic adapter can therefore be replaced by a symbolic assembly source that preserves F_DF98 byte layout while emitting its relocatable contribution sections in historical order. Whether that source arrangement is historical remains to be evidenced.

turbo_c_inline_org.description: Turbo C 2.0 inline assembly first emits a far call at ORG 6, then resets to ORG 0 and emits a second far call.
turbo_c_inline_org.result: Turbo C preserves inline-ASM contribution order in raw FIXUPP records; the high-offset call is recorded first.

shared_arithmetic_constraint.experiment: The complete F_DDD9..F_DF98 C candidate placed F_DF98 high (+65h) and entry (+00h) contributions with inline ORG.
shared_arithmetic_constraint.result: The F_DDD9/F_DE7E/F_DEFA compiler FIXUPP record was emitted before both F_DF98 records, so the complete ten-site historical descending sequence still did not emerge.
shared_arithmetic_constraint.required_property: A replacement must emit both F_DF98 contributions before the preceding arithmetic C contributions while retaining public offsets 0000h, 00A5h, 0121h and 01BFh and a contiguous 700-byte _TEXT extent.
shared_arithmetic_constraint.next_step: Recover the complete arithmetic interval as a coherent symbolic/mixed module, or identify a historical source emission mechanism with this record topology. Do not retain the object rewrite as final architecture.
